{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|eff= local

|gr1= Environment

|descr= Earthquake simulated through camera shake and sound. [[Arma 3: Stamina|Stamina]] is impacted by the earthquake too.
Earthquake will last between 13 and 20 seconds. While earthquake is in progress [[missionNamespace]] variable {{hl|BIS_fnc_earthquake_inprogress}} will be [[true]].

|exec= spawn

|s1= [intensity] spawn [[BIS_fnc_earthquake]]

|p1= intensity: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 2) can be 1, 2, 3 or 4. Any other value will fall back to the default value

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>[4] spawn BIS_fnc_earthquake;</sqf>

|seealso= [[addCamShake]]
}}
